fix.note: 바람이 불다 = the wind blows; 바람을 쐬다 = get fresh air.

ex.en: It's really windy today.
The wind is cold, so dress warmly.
Let's step outside and get some fresh air.

fix.note: Casual form of 이야기; 얘기하다 = to talk.

ex.en: What are you talking about?
Did you hear about that?
Grandma told us stories from the old days.
I still haven't made a decision.
It was a really tough decision.
Quitting your job was the right decision.
I'm signing the lease for the house next week.
I signed a one-year contract with the company.
Read the contract carefully.

ex.s: 그 식당은 한번 가 볼 가치가 있어요.
ex.en: That restaurant is worth a visit.
This watch has gone up a lot in value.
Family is worth more than money.
Wow, the trip plan is perfect!
Your Korean is almost perfect!
It's okay not to be perfect.
Could you explain it once more?
The doctor explained the test results.
It's hard to explain the directions.

notes: Mostly clean. 얘기/결정 examples duplicated the 얘기하다/결정하다 entries, so gave them noun uses; fixed 한번 spacing, phone 계약 (약정), translationese, a risky medical claim.
